answer: When a fake is caught, the penalty should ripple back along the grades that held it up. Every high grade is a tie on a trellis: if the vine it held proves to be a sybil, each grader who scored it above the panel median loses a slice of that epoch's grading pay, like a framer who signed off on rotten timber. A ring propping up its own clones then pays for every catch. Evasion: ring members grade each other at the median, which drops the boost the ring existed for. Wrongly hit: honest graders fooled by a good fake, so the slice stays small (assume 10%) and never touches standing.
